# Tauri app store — key-value persistence with Store vs LazyStore

Curated by Skill Harbor — @full-stack-skills' tauri-app-store skill: guidance for the Tauri v2 store plugin — lightweight persistent storage for app settings, the Store vs LazyStore decision based on load timing, storage file location and schema definition, capability/scope restriction, and persistence lifecycle and error handling, with links to the official v2.tauri.app store docs. It produces store-selection guidance and a settings persistence plan, with a declared boundary (store plugin usage only — Store vs LazyStore differences).
